title: Felix and the Provision
author: J. M. Almeida
blurb: Jonah Brightwater, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
